description: cargo test --workspace on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership after fz-hwn.19.6 transport cleanup reached tests/fixture_matrix.rs and failed 85 fixture-matrix cases while cargo test --lib, cargo check --all-targets, clippy, and the fz2 multi_relay dump/telemetry transport signal passed. Representative failures: continuation_materialization_boundaries_stay_explicit reports native callable materialization for FunctionId(65)/0 matched multiple published boundaries; enum_map_family times out its fz2 drive; multiple run/build fixture legs panic in runtime float/closure paths. This is outside the focused transport cutover matrix but should be triaged before treating cargo test --workspace as a required green gate.
